rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing for reduction kernels should always include extreme value testing with values near the identity element boundaries. Test with values in ranges like (-FLT_MAX, -1e10], (-1e10, 0], [0, 1e10), and [1e10, FLT_MAX) to catch initialization boundary bugs.
